long_metadata.title: The Full Corporate Tech Reality Check
long_metadata.description:
Alright, another multi-billion dollar EV recall is in the headlines. Turns out, their hyper-advanced touchscreens are brilliantly preventing you from executing the complex maneuver of… rolling down a window. Because nothing says progress like needing a software patch to feel a breeze. Subscribe for more corporate burns.

short_metadata.title: Why Big Tech is Overrated
short_metadata.description:
Alright, gather 'round, corporate masochists.

Tech Megacorp just laid off 10,000 employees, citing 'strategic realignments' and 'optimizing for the future' – which, apparently, means zero human jobs. That future? A shiny new AI chatbot that believes the capital of France is a delightful mushroom bisque and currently specializes in hallucinating revolutionary clam chowder recipes. So yeah, your livelihood was deemed less valuable than an algorithm that thinks the stock market runs on gazpacho. Tastes like progress, doesn't it?
